name: opensre
description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
one_liner: An on-call assistant for broken software builds: it reads the failure log, works out what actually went wrong, and drafts a fix a human just has to approve.
buyer: A small startup's engineering lead who doesn't have a dedicated site-reliability engineer and is tired of losing mornings to red CI pipelines.
business_use_cases: A fractional DevOps contractor adds 'automated CI triage' to their existing retainer offering for multiple small clients at once.
A platform engineering team at a mid-size company self-hosts it with their own models to keep code and logs from leaving their network.
A build-reliability startup wraps it in a dashboard that shows leadership exactly how many engineering hours were saved per month.

money_ideas.idea: A per-team monthly retainer for a managed, always-on CI triage service
A one-time setup fee to self-host and integrate it into a company's existing CI pipeline

steal_this: Deploy it against your own noisiest CI pipeline this weekend, screenshot the time saved, and use that as the pitch for your first paid client.
